hook: Peeche aati gaadi ki steering par... koi insaan tha hi nahi!
feedback: Solid, highly atmospheric script with a strong twist. 1) Cut 1 & 2 hook execution is great (cold open into flash-forward shocker). 2) In Cut 5, Ashwin speaks, but he isn't established with a quick close-up/emotional connection first—move Cut 2's focus slightly earlier to build empathy for Ashwin's panicked rush to his father before the ghost car appears. 3) The script duration (around 66s) is slightly longer than the 40-58s sweet spot; trim 1-2 filler cuts (e.g., merge Cut 8 and Cut 9) to tighten the pacing.
lines: Peeche aati gaadi ki steering par... koi insaan tha hi nahi!
Raat teen baje Munnar ke khatarnaak ghat par Ashwin ki jeep dhalan utar rahi thi.
Ghar se call aaya tha, papa ki tabiyat bahut jyada kharab thi.
Mani uncle, thoda fast chalao na, urgent hai!
Tabhi navein mod par, ek kaali Bolero tej headlights maarte hue chipak gayi.
Mani ne steering kas ke pakdi, 'ise rasta mat dena beta!'
Ashwin ne side mirror dekha... driver cabin khali tha!
Gaadi ne overtake karke theek saamne break maar di!
Mani ne hard break dabaya, jeep khai ke kinare ruk gayi.
Usi pal didi ka voice note aaya.
'Ashwin, papa ek ghante pehle guzar gaye... aakhiri baar bol rahe the, maine Ashwin ka rasta rok diya hai...'
Saamne dekha to aage ki sadak toot kar khai mein gir chuki thi!
Wah saya girane nahi... apne bete ki jaan bachane aaya tha.
Raat ko peeche aati gaadiyon ki steering par dhyaan zaroor dena.
